import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import checks
import re
text = open('src/gaps.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
found = re.findall(r'^(\d+)\. \*\*(.+?)\*\*', text, re.M)
titles = ['The chain is per thread.', 'A refusal is not an event.', 'A worktree is removed, then pruned.', 'The output cap is 65,536 bytes.', 'The lock is advisory on Windows.', 'A setup step is a check by name.']
assert [int(n) for n, _ in found] == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], 'gaps.md entries must be numbered 1 to 6 in file order (old 4, 5, 7, 8 become 3, 4, 5, 6); got %r' % [n for n, _ in found]
assert [t for _, t in found] == titles, 'gaps.md titles must stay as they were, in order; got %r' % [t for _, t in found]
